what_this_is: Words and names for Ask my AI (src/workspace/ask-my-ai.ts): the one way a screen asks the person's own AI and gets its answer back. `definition_prefix` is how a screen's dispatch names a job row of src/queued-work.json (ask-my-ai:<job id>); `result_text_keys` are where a finished job's result may carry its words when it has no `show` cards, tried in order.
no_answer: Your AI finished without sending any words back. Open AI work to see what it did.
